g.text: High flood risk detected near Central
Avoid this area immediately and use the verified alternate
✓ Bypasses Central Road via North Parkway.
• Avoid the area immediately. Do not attempt to walk or drive
• Move immediately to higher elevation or designated shelter (East Civic).
• Follow official emergency siren & municipal instructions.
If In Warning or High Risk:
• Check updated nowcast every 15 minutes before traveling.
Normal travel permitted. Keep phone charged and monitor
